title: Standardize per-record ownership (BOLA) via IOwnedEntity + auth filter
note: Pattern is shipped (IOwnedEntity, RequireOwnershipAttribute, OwnedEntityActionFilter, BaseController.EnsureOwnedAsync). No existing template entity adopts it yet — adoption is per-feature, decided by the consuming project.
summary: Adds an IOwnedEntity marker interface ({ string OwnerUserId }) and an OwnedEntityActionFilter that enforces request user == record owner on Get/Edit/Delete unless the user has an admin access function. Provides a base controller helper EnsureOwnedAsync<T>(id) for non-attribute paths.

filesEdited.reason: Add EnsureOwnedAsync<T>(id) helper that resolves the entity, compares OwnerUserId to UserId, returns 403 if mismatch and current user is not admin
Optional: filter list queries to current user's records when the entity implements IOwnedEntity (admin sees all)
